info.name: GoFixCarz Admin API — Postman Requests (PRODUCTION TARGET)
info.description:
PRODUCTION TARGET: this collection sends requests to https://api.gofixcarz.com/api/v1. GET requests read production data. POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE requests may modify live accounts, garages, tickets, announcements, exports or other records; do not run the collection or send mutations as a test. Use only with production authorization and real, intended IDs.

Set the local Postman variable base_url to https://api.gofixcarz.com/api/v1 (this value already includes /api/v1). Set adminEmail/adminPassword only in a private Postman environment. Run Sign In, then Complete MFA if challenged. Keep access/refresh tokens secret.

Protected admin routes are appended as /admin/...; private authentication routes as /admin-auth/.... Use the dedicated admin token. Many write actions require recent MFA and expected_version. Announcement sends are IN_APP only. Financial/customer/review results depend on authentic source records.

item.name: 00 Private Authentication
item.description: Private admin auth endpoints are intentionally excluded from public OpenAPI. Do not share TOTP seeds, passwords or tokens.

request.description: Private admin password verification. If MFA is required, the response contains challenge_id and (on first enrollment only) provisioning_uri. Add the URI to an authenticator, then use Complete MFA. Never share the provisioning URI or tokens.

Enter the current six-digit TOTP from the enrolled authenticator. The example code is a placeholder. Challenge expires after five minutes and is single-use. Copy data.access_token to the Postman environment variable adminToken and data.refresh_token to refreshToken.
Refresh tokens rotate: copy the newly returned access_token and refresh_token over the old environment values. Reusing the old refresh token revokes its family.
Revoke the current dedicated admin session. Requires Bearer {{adminToken}}.
Admin identity; no owned garage is required.
